It was contested by 20 teams, and [[R.W.D. Molenbeek (1909)|R.W.D. Molenbeek]] won the championship. At the end of the season the division was reduced in size from 20 to 19 clubs, so three clubs were relegated, with two clubs promoted from [[Belgian Second Division|Division II]] to replace them.<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |title=Belgium – Final Tables 1895–2008 |publisher=The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |last1=Ploquin |first1=Phil |last2=Nackaerts |first2=Luc |last3=Coolsaet |first3=Jeroen |access-date=17 December 2018}}</ref>
